name: class_union_arm_collection_class_field_stays_fallback
description: FALLBACK-BOUNDARY GUARD (family: union_class_optional_field) — the same boundary one level DOWN, inside a collection. A{items list<B>} | C{name string} where B{x int, y string?} carries an OPTIONAL field. checkSupportedType treats a class reference as a LEAF (class definitions are validated once over the bundle's class slice under the ORDINARY field rules), so validating the list field with it alone would let B bypass the union-arm optional-field boundary that class_union_optional_field_arm_stays_fallback locks at depth 0. BAML's Class::try_cast fills B's missing optional with OptionalDefaultFromNoValue and SUCCEEDS at a NON-zero score — landing the A arm in try_cast_union's pick_best sub-path — where tryCastClass does not match at all, so the two phases disagree about which arms even compete. checkUnionCollectionClasses closes it by holding every class reachable through a union arm's collection to the union-arm rules. A collection of an IN-SCOPE class (all required flat leaves) still CLAIMS; only this shape declines. want live-captured from BAML v0.223 final parse.
